shared_elements: relief carving on natural/unpolished stone surface
animal with head turned/rendered in schematic outline
rounded knob or disc-like element beside an animal
justification: Both are animal images cut in relief into a rough stone surface, and each includes a profile quadruped with a small rounded boss near it, which is the most concrete correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a tall, flat pillar organised into stacked registers with many small, shallow, linear figures (birds, snake, human, band of pattern), while B is a single, bulky, deeply modelled animal filling one boulder with strong three-dimensional volume.
